> Source of truth: https://barakode.com — Last updated: 2026-06-10.

## Summary

Barakode Technologies (brand name: "Barakode") is a full-cycle software
development agency that engineers web, mobile, AI, and cloud products for
startups and enterprises worldwide. Tagline: "Engineering Solutions.
Delivering Results." The company is based in Pakistan and serves clients
globally, including the USA and Saudi Arabia. Working languages: English and
Arabic.

Website: https://barakode.com

## What Barakode does

Barakode is an end-to-end ("full-cycle") software partner. A typical
engagement runs from discovery and architecture through UI/UX design,
engineering, QA, launch, and long-term support. The team specializes in
modern web and mobile stacks, cloud infrastructure, and applied AI/ML.

Areas of expertise: Web Development, Mobile App Development, Cloud Computing,
DevOps, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, UI/UX Design, Enterprise
Software, and Staff Augmentation.

## Services (detailed)

### Full-Stack Development — starts from $3,599
React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, REST APIs, and enterprise web applications.
End-to-end product builds with clean architecture and production-grade code.

### Mobile App Development
React Native, Flutter, and native iOS/Android. Cross-platform apps that share
a codebase without compromising on native feel.

### AI / Machine Learning
LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) chatbots, computer
vision, and recommendation engines. Practical AI features shipped into real
products.

### Cloud & DevOps — starts from $1,399
AWS, GCP, Azure, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code. Tooling includes
Docker, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Netlify, and Firebase.

### UI/UX & Product Design — starts from $599
Research-driven design, Figma prototyping, and reusable design systems.

### Staff Augmentation
Dedicated engineers embedded directly into your team to add capacity and
velocity without long hiring cycles.

## Pricing

Barakode offers two standard engagement plans (custom quotes available for
larger scope):

- **Standard Plan — $500 / project, 4–6 week delivery.** For clear
  requirements and a focused scope. Includes requirements & scope definition,
  UI/UX design in Figma, development in React or WordPress, remote
  collaboration, and delivery on business days.
- **Premium Plan — $1,000 / project, 4–12 week delivery.** Full-cycle
  development with a dedicated project manager.

Every engagement includes **full IP / code-ownership transfer** on final
delivery and payment, and **two structured revision rounds per milestone**.
Larger scope changes are quoted transparently before any extra work begins.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What is your typical project timeline?
A: It depends on scope. Simple integrations take about 1–2 weeks, while full
web or mobile applications usually take 6–16 weeks.

Q: What services does your agency offer?
A: Full-stack web and mobile development, AI/ML integration, cloud and DevOps,
UI/UX design, and staff augmentation.

Q: What is your revision policy?
A: Each milestone includes two structured revision rounds. Larger scope
changes are quoted transparently before any additional work begins.

Q: How do we get started working together?
A: Send a brief through the contact form. Barakode responds within 24 hours
with a clear plan, honest timeline, and a competitive quote.

Q: Will I own the rights to the code?
A: Yes — full IP transfer is included with every engagement upon final
delivery and payment.

Q: How do you approach a new software project?
A: Discovery first. The team maps requirements, defines architecture, locks
the stack, and only then starts engineering — with weekly demos.

## Engagement process

1. **Discovery** — map requirements, goals, and constraints.
2. **Architecture** — design the system and lock the technology stack.
3. **Design** — research-driven UI/UX in Figma.
4. **Development** — build with weekly demos and continuous testing.
5. **Launch & Support** — ship, then optimize and support post-launch.

## Selected work

- **Gman Stitching Platform** (2023) — Full-stack tailoring management
  platform built with Node.js, React, Prisma, Docker, and MySQL. Replaced a
  failing PHP/Laravel legacy system and achieved a 70% improvement in response
  time. URL: https://barakode.com/projects/gman
- **Beyut Libya — Real Estate Platform** (2025) — Real estate listing and
  management platform. URL: https://barakode.com/projects/beyut-libya
- **OpenInterview — Video Interview Platform** (2025) — A platform that gives
  job seekers one shareable profile with a video introduction, resume, and
  availability, removing hiring back-and-forth.
  URL: https://barakode.com/projects/openinterview

In-depth engineering case studies (with PDFs) are published at
https://barakode.com/case-studies covering machine learning, computer vision,
NLP, generative models, security, and systems programming.
